correctness.rationale: For a>|k| and 0<delta<T0, exponential matrix contraction provides a unique periodic centered Gaussian covariance. The exact matrix trace/off-diagonal subsystem is constant, leaving a solvable scalar square-wave variance difference. Period averaging yields the full-lag equilibrium covariance; Isserlis gives both fourth cumulants and exact squared-position covariance. Strict positivity of the derivative of F(z)=1-tanh(z)/z gives the unique crossing and complete boundary cases. Independent matrix-Lyapunov propagation and quadrature passed 639 assertions. No extrapolation from finite experiments is used in the proof.

value.rationale: The model describes a concrete periodically driven two-bath harmonic system. The entire second-order position time series is identical to equilibrium, so the negative-to-positive change of the natural cross-energy observable under temperature-switch period is a physically useful higher-order detection criterion. The theorem gives a complete, sharp normalized coupling/contrast frontier and uniqueness, a motivated structural classification not supplied by routine equilibrium covariance analysis.
